**Title:** Where the Chicago Bulls stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Chicago Bulls in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #37 Josh Giddey 59.5
- #64 Tre Jones 55.8
- #91 Norman Powell 53.3
- #126 Nic Claxton 49.5
- #156 Jalen Smith 47.1
- #165 Matas Buzelis 46.3
- #182 Caleb Wilson 45.3 (rookie)
- #289 Buddy Hield 39.0

Rookies start from a draft-slot prior. GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
